BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-PLAGUE_VIAL.title: Plague Vial
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-FUMIGATE.title: Fumigate
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-QUARANTINE.title: Quarantine
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-QUARANTINE.descrip:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Apply {Sway:diff()} Sway to ALL enemies with [gold]Plague[/gold].
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-INHALE_SPICES.desc: Choose one: Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to total [gold]Plague[/gold] on all enemies, or heal 10% of it, rounded up.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-INHALE_SPICES_BLOC: Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to total [gold]Plague[/gold] on all enemies.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-INHALE_SPICES_HEAL: Heal 10% of total [gold]Plague[/gold] on all enemies, rounded up.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-PANDEMIC.title: Pandemic
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-PANDEMIC.descripti: Apply {Plague:diff()} [gold]Plague[/gold] to ALL enemies, then trigger [gold]Plague[/gold] on ALL enemies.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-PATIENT_ZERO.title: Patient Zero
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-PESTILENCE.title: Pestilence
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-SEPTIC_CUT.title: Septic Cut
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-CONTAMINATED_GAUZE:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Apply {Plague} [gold]Plague[/gold] to a random enemy.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-SYMPTOM_CHECK.desc:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If any enemy has [gold]Plague[/gold], draw 1 card.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-FLEA_BITE.title: Flea Bite
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-FLEA_BITE.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the target already has [gold]Plague[/gold], apply {Plague} [gold]Plague[/gold].
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-MIASMA.title: Miasma
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-MIASMA.description: At the start of your turn, apply {PlaguePerTurn} [gold]Plague[/gold] to ALL enemies.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-ISOLATION_WARD.des: The first time each turn you apply [gold]Plague[/gold] to an enemy, gain {BlockOnPlague:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-INCUBATION.title: Incubation
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-INCUBATION.descrip: Increase an enemy's [gold]Plague[/gold] by {Percent:diff()}%, rounded up.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-CROSS_CONTAMINATIO: Apply {Percent:diff()}% of the target's [gold]Plague[/gold], rounded up, to every other enemy.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-TERMINAL_DIAGNOSIS:
Apply {Plague} [gold]Plague[/gold].
Then increase its [gold]Plague[/gold] by {Percent}%, rounded up.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-BLACK_TONIC.title: Black Tonic
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-BLACK_TONIC.descri:
Apply {SelfPlague} [gold]Plague[/gold] to yourself.
Gain {Energy:diff()} [gold]Energy[/gold]. Unspent Energy persists into your next turn.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-RELAPSE.title: Relapse
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-RELAPSE.descriptio: At the start of your turn, trigger [gold]Plague[/gold] on ALL enemies once for each Relapse.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-SEPTIC_JAB.title: Sample Extraction
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-SEPTIC_JAB.descrip:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the target has [gold]Plague[/gold], gain {Specimen} Specimen.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-CENSER_HOOK.title: Censer Hook
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-CENSER_HOOK.descri:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the target already has [gold]Plague[/gold], apply {Plague:diff()} more.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-DRAIN_THE_WOUND.de: Remove ALL [gold]Plague[/gold] from the target. Deal {Multiplier:diff()} times that much damage.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-SEPTIC_LANCE.title: Septic Lance
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-CONTAGIOUS_CUT.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Apply {Plague:diff()} [gold]Plague[/gold] to ALL enemies.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-VIRULENT_CUTS.desc: Whenever you deal unblocked Attack damage, apply {Plague:diff()} [gold]Plague[/gold] to the target.
At the end of your turn, apply {Plague} [gold]Plague[/gold] to ALL enemies.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-CONTAGIOUS_RUPTURE: Remove ALL [gold]Plague[/gold] from the target. Deal {Multiplier:diff()} times that much damage to ALL enemies.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-SEPTIC_EXECUTION.d:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Trigger the target's [gold]Plague[/gold] {Triggers:diff()} time(s).
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-BLACK_LANCET.title: Black Lancet
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-MUTATION.title: Mutation
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-MUTATION.descripti: At the start of your turn, increase [gold]Plague[/gold] on ALL enemies by {Percent:diff()}%, rounded up.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-LAST_PATIENT.title: Last Patient
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-LAST_PATIENT.descr: At the start of your turn, if no enemy has [gold]Plague[/gold], apply {Plague:diff()} [gold]Plague[/gold] to an enemy.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-CONTAGION_ENGINE.d: At the start of your turn, apply {Plague:diff()} [gold]Plague[/gold] to ALL enemies.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-PATHOLOGY_REPORT.d: Spend up to {SpecimenCap} Specimens. For each spent, draw 1 card and apply {PlaguePerSpecimen} [gold]Plague[/gold] to ALL enemies.
